data-n1.text: Base64 toolkit. Shows the options (standard or URL-safe alphabet, no wrap, MIME 76 CRLF or custom wrap, strict or lenient decoder, padding), text in and out with byte counts, a strict error that names the exact offset, a same-folder file job with progress, pause and cancel, and history with undo and redo. Try: Encode, Try a bad character then Decode in Strict and in Lenient, choose files, Undo. Unbuilt here: real files and the data: URL pane, which the app has.

data-n2.text: File converter. Shows the queue with byte-signature detection (a .dat that is really a PDF), the lossy-change disclosure that must be acknowledged before Convert, two-at-a-time progress with pause and cancel, per-file outcomes, and the categorised catalogue where unavailable rows name the missing adapter. Try: the switch then Convert, Pause, a category chip, the search and the .* regex toggle. Unbuilt: PDF, audio, video, office, RAR and 7z conversions, because no adapter for them is bundled.
